authority: CEO Round 136: 'Make the AI evaluate: source build vs reproducible package vs container vs HPC module. Choose the lowest-cost reproducible route that preserves solver provenance. Don't turn 22% compilation into sunk-cost bias.'
problem: OpenFOAM-9 source build is at 24% (1176/~4887 .o files) after multiple sessions. Each tool invocation compiles ~5-10 files. At this rate, completion requires ~2-3 more hours of continuous compilation. The tool environment kills processes after 10 minutes. Is source build the best route?

route_1_source_build.route: Build OpenFOAM-9 from github.com/OpenFOAM/OpenFOAM-9 source with Allwmake
route_1_source_build.provenance_quality: HIGH — exact source commit, exact compiler, exact build flags
route_1_source_build.reproducibility: HIGH — anyone can clone and build identically
route_1_source_build.blocking_issue: Tool environment kills background processes after 10 min. Build is incremental and resumable.
route_1_source_build.sunk_cost_bias_risk: MEDIUM — 24% complete, but remaining 76% is the same difficulty

route_2_conda_forge_openfoam_2412.current_status: INSTALLATION TIMED OUT twice — package is ~500MB+
route_2_conda_forge_openfoam_2412.time_cost: ~10-20 min if it completes (but keeps timing out)
route_2_conda_forge_openfoam_2412.provenance_quality: MEDIUM — conda-forge build, not official OpenFOAM Foundation build
route_2_conda_forge_openfoam_2412.solver_fidelity: PARTIAL — OpenFOAM 2412, not v9. clotFoam targets v9. API differences may break clotFoam build.
route_2_conda_forge_openfoam_2412.blocking_issue: conda install keeps timing out. Even if installed, clotFoam may not build against v2412.

route_3_docker_container.current_status: Docker NOT AVAILABLE in this environment
route_3_docker_container.blocking_issue: Docker not available (no docker, podman, apptainer)

route_4_prebuilt_deb_extract.route: Download OpenFOAM-9 .deb package and extract without sudo
route_4_prebuilt_deb_extract.reproducibility: MEDIUM — .deb extraction is non-standard but reproducible
route_4_prebuilt_deb_extract.blocking_issue: Need to find .deb URL and extract with dpkg-deb -x

ai_decision.rationale: Route 4 (prebuilt .deb extraction) has the best cost/probability ratio: LOW time cost, FULL fidelity (official v9), HIGH provenance, 0.70 probability of successful clotFoam build. If .deb extraction fails, fall back to route 1 (source build) which is already 24% complete and has 0 errors. Route 2 (conda 2412) has low clotFoam compatibility probability (0.30). Route 3 (Docker) is blocked.
ai_decision.next_action: Attempt to download OpenFOAM-9 .deb from openfoam.org and extract with dpkg-deb -x to user space. If that fails, continue source build.
ai_decision.anti_sunk_cost_rule: The 24% source build progress does NOT prevent switching to a faster route. The source build is incremental and can be abandoned without loss if a faster route succeeds.

resource_aware_acquisition_formula.formula: acquisition = EIG × P(resolving_highest_posterior) × independence_gain × decision_impact ÷ (compute_hours + installation_friction + validation_cost)

applied_to_C5_CONTRA_E01.compute_hours: clotFoam tutorial may take hours per CEO's note
applied_to_C5_CONTRA_E01.interpretation: High acquisition despite high cost because it directly resolves the highest-posterior hypothesis (H2=0.45) with external independence. No cheaper experiment can achieve this.
